name: eta-progress
title: ETA progress
description: A progress bar that says how long is left, from the real pace so far, with an estimate that is smoothed so the text stays calm.
docs: Pass value (0 to 1) and startedAt. The text says Calculating for the first seconds, then an estimate rounded to friendly steps that only changes when it has drifted meaningfully, then Almost done and Finished in 1 min 20 s. The bar's aria-valuetext holds the sentence, and the sentence is announced at most every 15 seconds. Pass finishedAt when you know when it ended; now freezes the clock for tests and snapshots.
